title: The Sanctions Are Back
summary:
US reverses relief of sanctions on Venezuela
Back in October 2023, the U.S. Treasury Department announced that it would ease sanctions against companies that trade in Venezuelan oil or invest in the country for an initial period of six months. The main reason for the partial relief of sanctions was to encourage Venezuela's President Nicolas Maduro to enable democratic elections to take place in July 2024.
